en: Vintage illustration-style New Year or festive postcard showing a bottle of sparkling wine labeled "CONCORDIA," two champagne flutes, an old-fashioned wooden mantel clock showing midnight, green fir branches, several four-leaf clovers, and a small red-and-white spotted mushroom (a fly agaric), arranged on a light-colored table. The right half of the card is blank for writing a message.
